name: proof-core
description: Seal, verify, and reproduce a computed result so a neutral party can independently re-run it and confirm it re-derives, tamper-evident, with no account and no network. Wraps the open (MIT) proof-core kernel v0.21.3, vendored into this plugin so it runs offline with no install. Use it to turn an agent's output into a re-runnable, tamper-evident evidence bundle.
